candidates.extracted_text: Item 1. Business NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NXPI) is a registrant under the Securities Exchange Act. NXP provides mixed-signal and automotive semiconductor solutions. Manufacturing uses a mix of internal and external capacity. Principal operations: NXP Semiconductors N.V.. Reported segments include: Automotive (56% of revenue); Industrial & IoT (28% of revenue); Mobile & Comm (16% of revenue). Our semiconductor business model is analog. We produce analog and mixed-signal devices.
